name: Jupiter Exitus
source:
A short kinetic novel about the astronaut Harper, who's on a suicide misson to save the Earth from a mysterious space phenomenon. 

Only his colleague and friend Beth is with him via intercom as he desperately tries not to lose this race against time and his dwindling oxygen supply - because everything, absolutely everything is at stake here.

[From [url=https://spicymotte.itch.io/jupiter-exitus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于宇航员哈珀的短篇动态小说，他正在执行一项自杀任务，以将地球从神秘的太空现象中拯救出来。

只有他的同事兼朋友贝丝通过对讲机与他在一起，他拼命地试图不输掉这场与时间和氧气供应日益减少的赛跑——因为这里的一切，绝对一切都岌岌可危。

[来自[url=https://spicymotte.itch.io/jupiter-exitus]Itch.io[/url]]
